decisive_items: The lesions followed the course of branches of the common plantar digital nerves without evidence of invasion
A small extension of high signal from the lateral aspect of one lesion resembled a “mouse-tail.”
response.rationale: The clinical presentation and imaging findings are most consistent with plexiform schwannoma, particularly the linear distribution of nodules and their relationship to the plantar digital nerves, as well as the presence of a 'mouse-tail' sign.

rejected.why: Lack of family history of neurofibromatosis and imaging characteristics not typical of neurofibroma
